문제: [Ex 1-A-1] to make or produce with difficulty (a. prosper / b. arise / c. penny / d. forge) [정답: d. forge]
Word List Example: Difficulties arose with his computer because it was old.
영어본문: At Christmas, children wait for St. Nicholas to bring gifts down the chimney.
한글해석: 크리스마스에 아이들은 성 니콜라스가 굴뚝으로 선물을 가져다주기를 기다린다.
column9: 베스는 그를 보았고 고양이에 대한 기억이 되살아났다.

문제: [Ex 1-A-2] a person who works with metal (a. iron / b. blacksmith / c. charitable / d. benefactor) [정답: b. blacksmith]
Word List Example: The student's benefactor gave him money to spend on his studies.
영어본문: But it's not just a story.
한글해석: 하지만 그것은 단순한 이야기가 아니다.

문제: [Ex 1-A-3] to keep something going (a. exceed / b. sustain / c. preach / d. occupy) [정답: b. sustain]
Word List Example: The blacksmith pounded the piece of metal until it was flat.
영어본문: St. Nicholas was a real person.
한글해석: 성 니콜라스는 실존 인물이었다.

문제: [Ex 1-A-4] a small area that is part of a country (a. ladder / b. province / c. encounter / d. compensate) [정답: b. province]
Word List Example: My sister was charitable enough to help me buy my first house.
영어본문: A long time ago, a man named Marcus occupied a house with his family.
한글해석: 옛날에 마커스라는 남자가 가족과 함께 한 집에 살고 있었다.
column9: 하지만 다음으로 무엇을 해야 할지 아무도 알지 못했다.

문제: [Ex 1-A-5] thinking oneself not to be too important (a. humble / b. satisfaction / c. chimney / d. modest) [정답: d. modest]
Word List Example: The cat was on the roof sitting next to the chimney.
영어본문: He was not modest.
한글해석: 그는 겸손하지 않았다.

문제: [Ex 1-B-1] benefactor (a. giver / b. an area / c. money / d. too much) [정답: a. giver]
Word List Example: Her boss compensated her for the extra work she did last week.
영어본문: He always told everybody he was the strongest man in the province.
한글해석: 그는 자신이 그 지방에서 가장 힘이 센 사람이라고 늘 모두에게 말했다.

문제: [Ex 1-B-2] compensate (a. where smoke goes / b. to shape metal / c. a tool used to climb / d. to pay someone in return) [정답: d. to pay someone in return]
Word List Example: I encountered a sea turtle while I was swimming.
영어본문: He worked hard, but he could barely sustain his family.
한글해석: 그는 열심히 일했지만, 가족을 간신히 부양할 수 있을 뿐이었다.

문제: [Ex 1-B-3] occupy (a. to be rich / b. to happen / c. to see someone you know / d. to be in a place) [정답: d. to be in a place]
Word List Example: Since I exceeded my limit, I decided to get rid of my credit cards.
영어본문: He wanted to save money and prosper.
한글해석: 그는 돈을 모아 부유해지기를 원했다.

문제: [Ex 1-B-4] iron (a. a baby / b. a type of metal / c. a good feeling / d. a person who makes things with metal) [정답: b. a type of metal]
Word List Example: Stacy and Heather forged their friendship when they were teenagers.
영어본문: Still, he could never earn a penny more than he needed.
한글해석: 하지만 그는 필요한 것보다 단 1페니도 더 벌지 못했다.

문제: [Ex 1-B-5] exceed (a. to keep something going / b. to not talk about yourself too much / c. to be kind to others / d. to go past a certain limit) [정답: d. to go past a certain limit]
Word List Example: Even though Bob is the smartest boy in his class, he is humble.
영어본문: One day, Marcus made an agreement with a blacksmith.
한글해석: 어느 날 마커스는 대장장이와 계약을 맺었다.

문제: [Ex 2-1] Which of the following is a form of money? (a. A province / b. A penny / c. A blacksmith / d. A ladder) [정답: b. A penny]
Word List Example: The horse had shoes made of iron.
영어본문: The blacksmith had a lot of work to do.
한글해석: 대장장이는 해야 할 일이 많았다.

문제: [Ex 2-2] If you meet a boy on the street, you _____ him. (a. exceed / b. occupy / c. encounter / d. sustain) [정답: c. encounter]
Word List Example: He used a ladder to climb to the top of his tree house.
영어본문: But he couldn't do it all by himself.
한글해석: 하지만 혼자서는 그 일을 다 할 수 없었다.

문제: [Ex 2-3] Which of the following is a good feeling? (a. Modest / b. Humble / c. Satisfaction / d. Charitable) [정답: c. Satisfaction]
Word List Example: Derek is very modest for someone who is so rich.
영어본문: Marcus wanted to help him forge iron.
한글해석: 마커스는 그를 도와 철을 벼리는 일을 하고 싶어 했다.

문제: [Ex 2-4] Which one is part of a house? (a. Forge / b. Compensate / c. Arise / d. Chimney) [정답: d. Chimney]
Word List Example: Kevin and Alice occupied the chairs and had a long discussion.
영어본문: The blacksmith agreed to compensate him with a lot of money.
한글해석: 대장장이는 그에게 많은 돈으로 보상해 주기로 약속했다.

문제: [Ex 2-5] Which word relates to the word religion? (a. Iron / b. Preach / c. Benefactor / d. Prosper) [정답: b. Preach]
Word List Example: U.S. President Abraham Lincoln is on the penny.
영어본문: In the same town, there was a man named Nicholas.
한글해석: 같은 마을에 니콜라스라는 남자가 살고 있었다.

문제: [Ex 2-6] Which of the following means to happen? (a. Sustain / b. Arise / c. Province / d. Prosper) [정답: b. Arise]
Word List Example: Aaron often preached about living an honest life.
영어본문: At an early age, Nicholas started preaching.
한글해석: 어린 나이에 니콜라스는 설교를 시작했다.

문제: [Ex 2-7] Which of the following do people use to reach high places? (a. A chimney / b. A blacksmith / c. A benefactor / d. A ladder) [정답: d. A ladder]
Word List Example: Frank's new business finally prospered after many years of hard work.
영어본문: But he also believed that he should be humble and charitable.
한글해석: 하지만 그는 자신이 겸손하고 자비로워야 한다고 믿었다.

문제: [Ex 2-8] If you are smart with your money, then what will happen to you? (a. You will occupy a jail cell / b. You will forge a strong relationship / c. You will prosper / d. You will become humble) [정답: c. You will prosper]
Word List Example: Canada is divided into several different provinces.
영어본문: He learned that helping people gave him even more satisfaction than preaching.
한글해석: 그는 사람들을 돕는 것이 설교하는 것보다 훨씬 더 큰 만족을 준다는 것을 배웠다.

문제: [Ex 2-9] If someone gives money to others, we could say that they are (a. charitable / b. modest / c. prosper / d. exceed) [정답: a. charitable]
Word List Example: Brad was filled with satisfaction when he saw what was for dinner.
영어본문: One day, Nicholas encountered Marcus.
한글해석: 어느 날 니콜라스는 마커스를 마주쳤다.

문제: [Ex 2-10] Which of the following describes someone who thinks they are no better than others? (a. Benefactor / b. Satisfaction / c. Humble / d. Compensate) [정답: c. Humble]
Word List Example: Wind power is a clean way to sustain a city with energy.
영어본문: Marcus told Nicholas about his agreement with the blacksmith.
한글해석: 마커스는 니콜라스에게 대장장이와의 계약에 대해 이야기했다.

문제: [RC-1] Which of the following is true about the job Marcus did? (a. He made pennies. / b. He was compensated unfairly. / c. He preached to people. / d. He barely sustained his family.) [정답: b. He was compensated unfairly.]
영어본문: I worked hard for him, Marcus said, "but a problem arose. Even though I worked for him, he didn't pay me."
한글해석: 나는 그를 위해 열심히 일했지만, 문제가 생겼다네. 그를 위해 일했음에도 그는 내게 돈을 주지 않았다네,라고 마커스가 말했다.

문제: [RC-2] Why didn't Nicolas tell people that he gave money away? (a. He prospered. / b. He didn't want to be modest. / c. He wanted to be humble. / d. He wasn't popular in the province.) [정답: c. He wanted to be humble.]
영어본문: Nicholas wanted to help Marcus.
한글해석: 니콜라스는 마커스를 돕고 싶었다.

문제: [RC-3] What was dropped down the chimney? (a. A penny / b. A ladder / c. Gold / d. A benefactor) [정답: c. Gold]
영어본문: That night, he went back to Marcus's house.
한글해석: 그날 밤, 그는 마커스의 집으로 돌아갔다.

문제: [RC-4] Why did Marcus want more money? (a. To buy more iron / b. To feed his family / c. To give it away / d. To become a blacksmith) [정답: b. To feed his family]
영어본문: He brought a bag of gold.
한글해석: 그는 금화 한 자루를 가져왔다.

문제: [RC-5] How did Nicholas deliver the gold to Marcus? [정답: Nicholas climbed up a ladder and dropped the bag of gold down the chimney.]
영어본문: It exceeded the amount that Marcus needed.
한글해석: 그것은 마커스에게 필요한 액수를 초과하는 양이었다.

영어본문: Nicholas climbed up a ladder and dropped the bag of gold down the chimney.
한글해석: 니콜라스는 사다리를 타고 올라가 굴뚝 아래로 금화 자루를 떨어뜨렸다.

영어본문: Marcus thanked his benefactor.
한글해석: 마커스는 자신의 은인에게 감사해했다.

영어본문: Soon, people found out about Nicholas's gift.
한글해석: 곧 사람들은 니콜라스의 선물에 대해 알게 되었다.

영어본문: He became well known and loved.
한글해석: 그는 널리 알려지고 사랑받게 되었다.

영어본문: Even today, people still give secret gifts to children. And we say they are from St. Nicholas.
한글해석: 오늘날에도 사람들은 여전히 아이들에게 비밀 선물을 주며, 그것이 성 니콜라스가 준 것이라고 말한다.
